app_summary: An online shop selling astronomy products, based on the OpenTelemetry Demo. It is built with polyglot microservices (Go, Java, .NET, Python, Node.js, Rust, ...) communicating via gRPC and HTTP behind an Envoy frontend-proxy, with Kafka for asynchronous order processing and Valkey as cart store. Supported Operations: View product catalog, Receive product recommendations and ads, Add item to cart, Checkout with selected items, Currency conversion, Process payment, Generate shipping quotes, Send order confirmation emails

symptoms.potential_symptom: Cart service cannot access its cart storage (redis) causing FailedPrecondition errors
symptoms.evidence: Pod logs: "Error status code 'FailedPrecondition' with detail 'Can't access cart storage. System.ApplicationException: Wasn't able to connect to redis'"; Trace (traceID=73f803e9...): error contains "Can't access cart storage. System.ApplicationException: Wasn't able to connect to redis" referencing cartstore.ValkeyCartStore.EnsureRedisConnected()

symptoms.potential_symptom: Shipping service refusing TCP connections on port 8080 causing downstream shipping-quote failures
symptoms.evidence: Multiple traces (e.g., traceID=3b470f92...) error_message: "13 INTERNAL: shipping quote failure: failed POST to shipping service: Post \"http://shipping:8080/get-quote\": dial tcp 10.96.32.79:8080: connect: connection refused"; shipping pod logs show OTLP export network error: "Operation failed: HTTP export failed: network error" and pod describe shows shipping pod is Running and Ready (IP 10.244.1.24) which suggests connection attempts to the service ClusterIP (10.96.32.79) are being refused.
